summary: Bluerock Acquisition Corp., a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive Business Combination Agreement dated July 31, 2026, with Bitonic Technology Labs Inc. d/b/a Yellow.ai (target) and BLRK Merger Sub Inc. The boards of all parties unanimously approved the transaction. Bluerock will domesticate from a Cayman Islands entity to a Delaware corporation prior to closing, expected in the second half of 2026, subject to shareholder approval and customary conditions. The filing covers the material agreement, direct financial obligation, unregistered equity sales, and Regulation FD disclosure. No financial terms (price per share, premium, or trust value) were stated. Watch for the forthcoming shareholder vote, proxy statement, and any redemption dynamics as typical de-SPAC mechanics.
